entities.summary: Axel Gudbrand Blytt was a Norwegian professor, botanist and geologist. He was the author of a number of books regarding the flora of Norway. Today he is most associated with his role in developing the Blytt-Sernander theory of climatic change. Axel Gudbrand Blytt was a writers & intellectuals from Christiania (1843-05-19, Christiania–1898-07-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
